name: Jimnah
title: Son of Asher
summary: Jimnah (also known as Jimna or Imnah) was the firstborn son of Asher, who was one of Jacob's twelve sons. He was among the seventy people in Jacob's household who went down to Egypt. As a patriarch, he became the founder of the clan of the Jimnites among Asher's descendants.

keyEvents.title: Born as Asher's firstborn
keyEvents.description: Jimnah was the firstborn son of Asher, Jacob's eighth son. He became part of Jacob's extended family in the land of Canaan.

keyEvents.title: The Journey to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Jimnah was among the seventy members of Jacob's household who went down to Egypt during the famine, where Joseph provided for them.

keyEvents.title: Registered in Asher's genealogy in the Book of Numbers
keyEvents.description: Jimna is mentioned as the founder of the clan of the Jimnites in the census of the tribes of Israel on the plains of Moab.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in 1 Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Jimna is listed in the genealogy of Asher's descendants in the Books of Chronicles, confirming his place in the tribal history of Israel.
